description: Complex Event Processing (CEP) Rules Configuration for Notification Delivery Platform

rules.name: Message Deduplication Rule
rules.description: Suppress identical messages sent to the same user within a 5-minute sliding window
rules.reason: Duplicate message suppressed within 5-minute deduplication window

rules.name: SMS Channel Hourly Rate Limit
rules.description: Drop SMS messages if a user has already received 3 SMS notifications in the last 1 hour
rules.reason: Exceeded rate limit of 3 SMS notifications within 1 hour

rules.name: Philippines Quiet Hours Routing
rules.description: Delay non-critical notifications for users in Philippines during quiet hours (10:00 PM to 06:00 AM) until 06:00 AM
rules.reason: Delayed until morning (06:00 AM) due to regional quiet hours policy (10 PM - 6 AM)

rules.name: Security & Fraud Content Filter
rules.description: Filter or block messages containing forbidden spam/fraud terms
rules.reason: Message contains prohibited keyword or fraudulent pattern
